subject: general
question: By selling an article at (4)/(14) of its actual selling price, Akash incurs a loss of 30%. If he sells it at 54% of its actual selling price, then the profit percentage is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Cost Price (CP) = 100. Since the loss is 30%, initial SP = 70.

Actual SP = 70 × (14 ÷ 4) = 245.

New SP = 54% of Actual SP = 0.54 × 245 = 132.3.

Profit = 132.3 − 100 = 32.3% (approx 32.2% matching the nearest option).

**∴ The correct answer is 32.2%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling price 1 (SP₁) = 4/14 of Actual SP.

Loss at SP₁ = 30%.

Selling price 2 (SP₂) = 54% of Actual SP.

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 Actual SP = 245

 
 SP₁ = 70

 
 SP₂ = 132.3

 
 CP = 100

 

 × 4/14

 

 × 54%

 

 -30% Loss

 

 +32.3% Profit

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the Cost Price (CP) be 100 units.

⇒ Since the loss is 30% at SP₁, the value of SP₁ = 100 − 30 = 70.

⇒ According to the question: SP₁ = (4 ÷ 14) × Actual SP.

⇒ Actual SP = 70 × (14 ÷ 4) = 980 ÷ 4 = 245.

⇒ The new selling price (SP₂) is 54% of Actual SP.

⇒ SP₂ = (54 ÷ 100) × 245 = 0.54 × 245 = 132.3.

⇒ Profit = SP₂ − CP = 132.3 − 100 = 32.3 units.

⇒ Profit Percentage = (32.3 ÷ 100) × 100% = 32.3%.

⇒ The closest matching option provided is 32.2%.

**∴ The correct answer is 32.2%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cost Price & Selling Price

Cost price (CP) is the base value on which profit or loss is calculated. Selling price (SP) = CP × (100 ± Profit/Loss)%.

Marked Price & Discount

Marked price (MP) is the listed price. Discount is always calculated on MP. SP = MP × (100 − Discount)%.

Successive Percentage Change

When a value is changed successively by a% and b%, the net change is given by the formula: (a + b + a × b ÷ 100)%.
